name: freeagentcoder
displayName: Free Agent Coder: Free AI Coding Agent & Chat, Copilot & Cursor Alternative
description: Free AI coding agent and chat for VS Code, a free alternative to Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex and Claude Code. Plans, edits, runs and tests your code on free Gemini, Groq or OpenRouter keys, or your own Claude or OpenAI key, and fixes the errors your editor reports. Fyx does everyday chores with zero tokens. No subscription, open source.

freeagentcoder.usageDataEndpoint.markdownDescription: Where anonymous usage counts are sent, if you have agreed to send any. Leave empty to use the project's own site. Nothing is sent unless you said yes in **FreeAgentCoder: Anonymous Usage Data**.

freeagentcoder.labToken.markdownDescription: For the project's own testing: the token from the admin Test lab. When set, **FreeAgentCoder: Run a Test Task** runs a test task in the open folder and sends its results to the Test lab. Leave empty.

freeagentcoder.fyx.markdownDescription: **Fyx** does everyday tasks on your machine without an AI model: zipping and unzipping, git (status, pull, push, commit with your message, branches, clone, fork), installing and adding packages, running your project's scripts, creating, moving and copying files, and counting lines or sizes. They finish in seconds and use no tokens, and every command still asks the usual permission. It also learns: a short request the AI agent finished with a single command is done by Fyx the next time. Anything else goes to the AI agent as usual.

freeagentcoder.taskTokenLimit.markdownDescription: The most tokens one task may use before it pauses and asks you to continue. It protects a daily free allowance, and a paid key, from a task that runs away. Nothing is lost when it pauses: press **Continue**. `0` turns the limit off.

freeagentcoder.editorErrorsAfterEdit.markdownDescription: After each edit, give the agent the errors the editor finds in the changed file (type, lint and syntax errors), so it fixes them at once. An edited file is shown in a preview tab, since language servers only check files that are open.

freeagentcoder.checkPages.markdownDescription: Before the agent may call a plain web page done, load it in a hidden browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium already on this computer) and send any error back to be fixed. The page is served from this computer only (127.0.0.1) and nothing is sent anywhere. Skipped when no such browser is installed.

freeagentcoder.openPreview.markdownDescription: When a task makes a new web page or leaves a dev server running, show it beside your code. A plain page is served from this computer only (127.0.0.1). Turn off to open previews only from the **Open preview** button.

freeagentcoder.freeTrial.markdownDescription: Until you add a key of your own, run tasks on FreeAgentCoder's free trial: a daily allowance on the project's keys. Those requests go through FreeAgentCoder's server to the provider. Turn off to use only your own keys.

freeagentcoder.specialistUpdates.markdownDescription: Once a day, check the project's site for updated specialist instructions (how debugging, building, design and other kinds of work are approached). A plain request that sends nothing about you or your project. Turn off to keep the built-in instructions only.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with FreeAgentCoder
walkthroughs.description: A free AI coding agent, always one click away on the left bar. Three steps and you are coding.

steps.title: Find FreeAgentCoder: it is always on screen
steps.description:
FreeAgentCoder has three places that are always there, so you never need the Command Palette:
1. Its **icon on the left bar**: click it for the chat.
2. The **FreeAgentCoder button at the top right** of any editor: opens the chat as a tab beside your code. VS Code reopens it when you start again.
3. **FreeAgentCoder at the bottom right**, in the status bar.
[Open FreeAgentCoder](command:freeagentcoder.open)

media.altText: The VS Code window with the FreeAgentCoder icon on the left bar, its button at the top right of the editor and its item in the status bar

steps.title: Add a free API key
steps.description:
Get one free key from each of Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter. None of them asks for a card, and each is checked with a real request when you add it. The settings page has a direct link for each.
**One key per account:** a second key from the same account shares its limits and adds nothing.
Keys stay on this device, encrypted in VS Code Secret Storage.
[Add a free key](command:freeagentcoder.manageKeys)

media.altText: The API Keys page, with a direct link to get a free key from each provider

steps.title: Ask for your first task
steps.description:
Describe what you want in plain words: build a feature, fix a bug, or explain the code. Paste screenshots or PDFs if they help. FreeAgentCoder plans, edits, runs and checks the work, and shows every step.
[Open the chat](command:freeagentcoder.open)

media.altText: FreeAgentCoder working on a task: a plan, a file edit and live status

steps.title: Test your project
steps.description:
One click runs your project's own build, type check, lint and tests, then explains every failure in plain words with a fix.
[Test my project](command:freeagentcoder.testProject)

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
